title: Binance Futures Copy Trading Upgrades the Lead Trader Growth Plan
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures is excited to announce the upgrade of the Lead Trader Growth Plan. This upgrade provides lead traders with more options to access exclusive benefits and grow their portfolios. New Requirements for Lead Trader Growth Plan: Requirements Role Min. Margin Balance (USD) Min. 30-Day Copy Trader PNL (USD) Max. 7-Day MDD or Post on X/or Other  Social Media Channels Min. Binance Futures Copy Trading will review each lead trader’s application based on its internal requirements, and may reach out to applicants separately for more information. Successful applicants will be able to unlock the benefits in the following week based on their form submission. Notes: Please note that meeting these criteria does  not  guarantee the advanced benefits associated with the program.  All advanced benefits associated with the Lead Trader Growth Program are subject to the  applications  of qualified lead traders, as well as the internal reviews and approvals by the Binance Futures Copy Trading Team. The data presented in qualified lead traders’ portfolios will be used by Binance Futures Copy Trading to assess performance and determine eligibility for the advanced benefits. The performance of qualified lead traders in the Elite Trader Program will be reviewed on a  weekly basis .  Approved advanced benefits are not granted indefinitely. Binance reserves the right to conduct periodic reviews and promote and demote accounts for tier adjustments, in line with internal requirements. All metrics related to the program are measured by Binance at its sole and absolute discretion.  Binance reserves the right to, at its sole discretion, promote and demote accounts within the program. Binance reserves the right to cancel or amend the Program or Program rules at its sole discretion. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.  Guides & Related Materials: Binance Futures Copy Trading Lead Trader Growth Plan How to Lead Trade on Binance Copy Trading Lead Trader Benefits in Binance Copy Trading Thank you for your support!
